title: Warn when missing Power BI Account Categories Mappings
summary: The Power BI Reports Setup page now warns users when Power BI Account Categories mappings are missing, a common problem in customer setups. The check is implemented in the Finance Installation Handler codeunit.
key_points: Detects missing Power BI Account Categories mappings
Shows a warning on the PowerBI Reports Setup page
Check logic added to the Finance Installation Handler codeunit
Targets a frequent customer configuration issue
quote: Surfacing a common gotcha in customer scenarios.
